gaps.title: Missing dossier signature functionality
gaps.jtbd: When acting as an Epidemiologist (Старший научный сотрудник), I want to digitally sign or approve a generated dossier, so that the system fulfills the 'right to sign dossier' required by the brief.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given I am logged in as an Epidemiologist, When I view a generated dossier report, Then I can submit a signature/approval for the report.
gaps.reason: literal brief requirement ('с правом подписи досье' - with right to sign dossier) is not implemented in EmployeeDossierController or DossierReport

gaps.title: Missing dossier reports list pagination
gaps.jtbd: When retrieving dossier reports, I want to fetch a paginated list of all generated reports, so that I can browse reports efficiently without knowing their exact IDs.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given there are multiple dossier reports, When I call the reports list endpoint, Then I receive a paginated list of reports rather than just individual lookups.
gaps.reason: domain-standard expectation for a reporting system to have a paginated list endpoint for generated reports, not just single-item lookups by ID
